chunks.text:
The Woman in Love

paradox of love 

torture of the impossible love
where the woman wants to possess the man wholly, but also demands that he transcend any gift that could possibly be possessed. After all, we can’t possess people. Transcendence, freedom, those are not things that we can possess.


The woman in love also identifies the man.as the supreme goal of human love she thinks is identification with the loved one. The woman in love doesn’t just want to serve a man whom she’s taught to think is superior to her, but also tries to see the world through his eyes.
